panels.title: Energy
panels.description: PV = local PV house / workshop, consumption = load house + workshop (DC side), balance = PV - consumption

targets.rawQueryText:
-- sums over the selected range
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
h AS (
  SELECT v.name AS name, x.ts - x.ts % 3600 AS hr, SUM(x.value) AS s
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('LLOAD1_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH', 'LPV1_PROD_WH', 'LPV2_PROD_WH')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
p AS (
  SELECT 0 AS k,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD1_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD1_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD2_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV1_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV1_PROD_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV2_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV2_PROD_WH"
  FROM h
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ("LPV1_PROD_WH") / 1000.0 AS "PV house",
       ("LPV2_PROD_WH") / 1000.0 AS "PV workshop",
       ("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") / 1000.0 AS "PV total",
       ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Consumption",
       (("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") - ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH")) / 1000.0 AS "Balance"
FROM p

panels.title: Consumption breakdown
panels.description: Same categories as Loads per day (UHA Energy); Other = consumption - all categories. Share of the consumption total.

targets.rawQueryText:
-- sums over the selected range
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
h AS (
  SELECT v.name AS name, x.ts - x.ts % 3600 AS hr, SUM(x.value) AS s
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('AXPERT_LOAD_W', 'CONS_AXPERT_WH', 'CONS_EVSE_WH', 'CONS_FRIDGE_WH', 'CONS_KITCHEN_WH', 'CONS_OTHER_WH', 'CONS_TECHM_WH', 'CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH', 'CONS_WS_HEATING_WH', 'EL_HEATER_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD1_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
p AS (
  SELECT 0 AS k,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'AXPERT_LOAD_W' THEN s END), 0) / 4.0 AS "AXPERT_LOAD_W",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_AXPERT_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_AXPERT_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_EVSE_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_EVSE_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_FRIDGE_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_FRIDGE_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_KITCHEN_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_KITCHEN_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_OTHER_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_OTHER_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_TECHM_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_TECHM_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_WS_HEATING_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_WS_HEATING_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'EL_HEATER_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "EL_HEATER_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD1_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD1_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD2_CONS_WH"
  FROM h
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'Fridge' AS "Category", ("CONS_FRIDGE_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_FRIDGE_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Kitchen' AS "Category", ("CONS_KITCHEN_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_KITCHEN_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Washing machine' AS "Category", ("CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Technical room' AS "Category", ("CONS_TECHM_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_TECHM_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Other circuits' AS "Category", ("CONS_OTHER_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_OTHER_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Workshop' AS "Category", ("CONS_AXPERT_WH" - "CONS_EVSE_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_AXPERT_WH" - "CONS_EVSE_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'EV charger' AS "Category", ("CONS_EVSE_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_EVSE_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Workshop air conditioner' AS "Category", ("CONS_WS_HEATING_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_WS_HEATING_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Water heater' AS "Category", ("EL_HEATER_CONS_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("EL_HEATER_CONS_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Axpert losses' AS "Category", ("AXPERT_LOAD_W" - "CONS_AXPERT_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("AXPERT_LOAD_W" - "CONS_AXPERT_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Other' AS "Category", (("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") - ("CONS_FRIDGE_WH") - ("CONS_KITCHEN_WH") - ("CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH") - ("CONS_TECHM_WH") - ("CONS_OTHER_WH") - ("CONS_AXPERT_WH" - "CONS_EVSE_WH") - ("CONS_EVSE_WH") - ("CONS_WS_HEATING_WH") - ("EL_HEATER_CONS_WH") - ("AXPERT_LOAD_W" - "CONS_AXPERT_WH")) / 1000.0 AS "kWh", (("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") - ("CONS_FRIDGE_WH") - ("CONS_KITCHEN_WH") - ("CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH") - ("CONS_TECHM_WH") - ("CONS_OTHER_WH") - ("CONS_AXPERT_WH" - "CONS_EVSE_WH") - ("CONS_EVSE_WH") - ("CONS_WS_HEATING_WH") - ("EL_HEATER_CONS_WH") - ("AXPERT_LOAD_W" - "CONS_AXPERT_WH")) * 100.0 / NULLIF("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p
) ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Inverters - AC output (not part of the breakdown)
panels.description: AC energy per inverter meter, share of all inverters. Overload / lifetime view - never add it to the consumption breakdown.

targets.rawQueryText:
-- sums over the selected range
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
h AS (
  SELECT v.name AS name, x.ts - x.ts % 3600 AS hr, SUM(x.value) AS s
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('CONS_AC300_WH', 'CONS_AC3KW_WH', 'CONS_AC5KW_WH', 'CONS_AXPERT_WH', 'CONS_WS_HEATING_WH')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
p AS (
  SELECT 0 AS k,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_AC300_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_AC300_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_AC3KW_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_AC3KW_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_AC5KW_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_AC5KW_WH",

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'CONS_WS_HEATING_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "CONS_WS_HEATING_WH"
  FROM h
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'Inverter 300 W' AS "Inverter", ("CONS_AC300_WH") / 1000.0 AS "kWh", ("CONS_AC300_WH") * 100.0 / NULLIF("CONS_AC300_WH" + "CONS_AC3KW_WH" + "CONS_AC5KW_WH" + "CONS_AXPERT_WH" + "CONS_WS_HEATING_WH", 0) AS "Share" FROM p

panels.title: Energy per day

targets.rawQueryText:
-- sums per local day: counters = SUM of the 15 min increments, powers (_W) = SUM of the 15 min means / 4
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
h AS (
  SELECT v.name AS name, x.ts - x.ts % 3600 AS hr, SUM(x.value) AS s
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('LLOAD1_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH', 'LPV1_PROD_WH', 'LPV2_PROD_WH')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
p AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(hr, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS k,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD1_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD1_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD2_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV1_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV1_PROD_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV2_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV2_PROD_WH"
  FROM h
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', CAST(strftime('%m', k, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 3) || ' ' || CAST(strftime('%d', k, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) AS day,
       ("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Production",
       ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Consumption",
       (("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") - ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH")) / 1000.0 AS "Balance"
FROM p
ORDER BY k

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV1_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV1_PROD_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV2_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV2_PROD_WH"
  FROM h
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT k AS year,
       ("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Production",
       ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Consumption"
FROM p
ORDER BY k

-- sums per local year: counters = SUM of the 15 min increments, powers (_W) = SUM of the 15 min means / 4
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
h AS (
  SELECT v.name AS name, x.ts - x.ts % 3600 AS hr, SUM(x.value) AS s
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('LLOAD1_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH', 'LPV1_PROD_WH', 'LPV2_PROD_WH')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
p AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', hr, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS k,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD1_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD1_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LLOAD2_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV1_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV1_PROD_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'LPV2_PROD_WH' THEN s END), 0) AS "LPV2_PROD_WH"
  FROM h
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT k AS year,
       ("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Production",
       ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Consumption"
FROM p
ORDER BY k
